//go:build browser

// The auth topbar app's scriptless sign-out, copied in by rastrillo's
// internal/scaffoldcheck. The card's sign-out opts out of busy.js, so
// it must work as a plain form: with scripts off in the engine, the
// account card opens as a <details> and its Sign out button posts.
package signoutapp_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/background"
	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/db"
	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/harness"
	"github.com/chromedp/cdproto/cdp"
	"github.com/chromedp/cdproto/emulation"
	"github.com/chromedp/cdproto/network"
	"github.com/chromedp/chromedp"

	"signoutapp/internal/signoutapp"
)

const (
	card       = `[rst-shell-account]`
	signOut    = card + ` form[action="/signout"] button`
	signInLink = card + ` a[href="/signin"]`
)

func TestSignOutWorksWithScriptsOff(t *testing.T) {
	box := &outbox{}
	var app http.Handler
	rig := harness.New(t, func(origin string) http.Handler {
		logger := slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil))
		path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "app.db")
		database, err := db.Open(path, logger)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("db.Open: %v", err)
		}
		t.Cleanup(func() { database.Close() })
		group := &background.Group{}
		t.Cleanup(group.Stop)
		mux, _, err := signoutapp.New(database, origin, group, box, logger)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("New: %v", err)
		}
		app = mux
		return mux
	})
	// Signed in through the real screen and link, in process, presenting
	// the browser's origin, then handed to the browser as its cookie.
	session := signIn(t, fromOrigin(app, rig.Origin), box, "ada@example.com")
	rig.Run(
		call(emulation.SetScriptExecutionDisabled,
			emulation.SetScriptExecutionDisabledParams{Value: true}),
		call(network.SetCookies, network.SetCookiesParams{
			Cookies: []*network.CookieParam{{
				Name: session.Name, Value: session.Value,
				URL: rig.Origin + "/", Path: "/",
				Secure: session.Secure, HTTPOnly: true,
			}},
		}),
		chromedp.EmulateViewport(1280, 900),
		chromedp.Navigate(rig.Origin+"/"),
	)
	rig.Screen(card+" > summary", "the home page, signed in")
	// Evaluate runs with scripts off; the mark tells this document from
	// the one Sign out lands on.
	rig.Run(
		chromedp.Click(chromedp.CSS(card+" > summary")),
		chromedp.WaitVisible(chromedp.CSS(signOut)),
		chromedp.Evaluate[chromedp.Void](`window.signedInPage = true`),
		chromedp.Click(chromedp.CSS(signOut)),
	)
	settle(t, rig, `!window.signedInPage && document.readyState === "complete"`)
	rig.Screen("body", "the page Sign out lands on")
	if recorder := getAs(t, app, "/account", session); recorder.Code !=
		http.StatusSeeOther {
		t.Errorf("the old session still opens /account: %d, want 303",
			recorder.Code)
	}
	rig.Run(chromedp.Navigate(rig.Origin + "/"))
	rig.Screen(card+" > summary", "the home page, signed out")
	var offers string
	rig.Run(harness.Into(&offers, chromedp.Evaluate[string](
		`[...document.querySelectorAll('`+signInLink+`, `+signOut+`')]`+
			`.map(control => control.textContent).join()`)))
	if offers != "Sign in" {
		t.Errorf("signed out, the card offers %q; want Sign in alone",
			offers)
	}
}

// fromOrigin presents origin, the browser's, in place of testOrigin,
// which the sign-in helpers send and an app on the rig's origin refuses.
func fromOrigin(next http.Handler, origin string) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(
		writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request,
	) {
		if request.Header.Get("Origin") == testOrigin {
			request.Header.Set("Origin", origin)
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(writer, request)
	})
}

func call[P any](
	command cdp.Command[P, cdp.Empty], params P,
) chromedp.Action[chromedp.Void] {
	return chromedp.Func(
		func(ctx context.Context, target *chromedp.Target) error {
			_, err := cdp.Call(ctx, target, command, params)
			return err
		})
}
